title: Hunt Index
description_html: Queryable map over all hunt data (live + HDD backups). Use the canned queries below, browse tables, or write SQL.

search.sql: SELECT d.target, d.kind, d.path, snippet(fts,0,'','','…',15) AS hit FROM fts JOIN docs d ON d.id = fts.rowid WHERE fts MATCH :q ORDER BY rank LIMIT 200
search.title: Full-text search (notes/verdicts/reports/captures)

host.sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.target, h.host, d.kind, d.path FROM hosts h JOIN docs d ON d.id = h.doc_id WHERE h.host LIKE '%' || :host || '%' ORDER BY d.target LIMIT 500
host.title: Docs mentioning a host

requests_by_host.sql: SELECT method, status, url, target FROM requests WHERE host LIKE '%' || :host || '%' ORDER BY status LIMIT 500
requests_by_host.title: Captured requests for a host

program_docs.sql: SELECT kind, role, datetime(mtime,'unixepoch') AS t, path FROM docs WHERE target = :program ORDER BY mtime DESC LIMIT 500
program_docs.title: Every doc for a program

top_programs.sql: SELECT target, count(*) AS docs FROM docs WHERE target != '' GROUP BY target ORDER BY docs DESC LIMIT 100
top_programs.title: Doc count per program
